channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Nvidia's board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, and the shares jump about 30%
item.description: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on November 23 to bring back Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director, days after his resignation.

item.title: FCC approves SpaceX plan for up to one million AI data centre satellites
item.description: The FCC approved SpaceX's proposed Starmind network of up to one million satellites for computing in low Earth orbit.

item.title: GTA VI sold an estimated 44.9 million copies in its first four days
item.description: Alinea Analytics estimates GTA VI sold 44.9 million units and grossed over $4 billion by the end of its launch weekend.

item.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 designed proteins that bound to five targets in the lab
item.description: OpenAI reports that GPT-6 models designed protein sequences using reasoning and code, and lab tests found binding to five targets.

item.title: Focker-In-Law opens for Thanksgiving with Stiller and De Niro back
item.description: The fourth Meet the Parents film opened in cinemas on November 25, with Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro returning.

item.title: Sunrise on the Reaping opens to $120 million in the US and $225 million worldwide
item.description: The Hunger Games prequel opened to an estimated $120 million in North America and $225 million worldwide, AP reports.

item.title: US jury convicts Huawei on 10 of 12 counts in trade secrets case
item.description: A federal jury in Brooklyn found Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts in a long-running trade secrets and fraud case.

item.title: OpenAI preprint claims the matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4
item.description: OpenAI posted a maths preprint claiming the exponent of matrix multiplication is 9/4, a result not yet independently checked.

item.title: Academy rules fully AI-made film ineligible for Best Animated Feature
item.description: The Academy ruled that Gods Don't Give Gifts, a feature made entirely with generative AI, cannot compete for Best Animated Feature.

item.title: GTA VI gets its first big third-party discount in Loaded's Black Friday sale
item.description: Loaded's Black Friday sale cuts GTA VI on Xbox to $67.49 and discounts five of the six Game of the Year nominees.

item.title: CIA and US intelligence office reportedly hit by breach of unclassified data
item.description: Some unclassified information at the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence was breached, The New York Times reports.

item.title: Amazon says an open-source AI agent exploited an unknown flaw mostly on its own
item.description: Amazon reportedly detected an open-source AI agent exploiting a previously unknown vulnerability with limited human help.

item.title: Netflix streams Packers at Rams on Thanksgiving Eve with U2 at halftime
item.description: Netflix listed the Packers at Rams game for November 25, with a U2 halftime performance.

item.title: FBI's national crime database reportedly breached
item.description: A breach of the FBI's National Crime Information Center database has been reported, with its scope still unconfirmed.

item.title: SpaceX and Tesla reportedly name directors to negotiate a $3.5 trillion merger
item.description: SpaceX and Tesla have each named directors to negotiate a possible merger valued at $3.5 trillion, the Financial Times reports.

item.title: Anthropic says Claude agents moved its API from Python to Rust
item.description: Anthropic reports that Claude agents migrated its Messages API to Rust, cutting processor use per request by about 70%.

item.title: Disney's animated Hexed leads the Thanksgiving week cinema openings
item.description: Disney's Hexed opens wide on November 25, alongside Hershey, Bitter Christmas and A24's Club Kid, with Focker In-Law following on November 27.

item.title: ChatGPT merges Chat and Work limits, so heavy users may hit caps sooner
item.description: OpenAI says ChatGPT's Chat and Work modes will share one usage allowance, so people who use both heavily may hit limits sooner.

item.title: New York bans AI chatbot toys for five years
item.description: Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law banning the manufacture and sale of AI chatbot-powered toys in New York for five years.

item.title: Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video with all eight episodes on November 25
item.description: All eight episodes of Blade Runner 2099, starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer, stream on Prime Video from today, November 25.

item.title: Ransomware group lists Nvidia as a victim, and Nvidia is investigating
item.description: A ransomware group named Nvidia on its leak site, and Nvidia says it is investigating the claim.

item.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to let Meta's Muse agent shop on Amazon
item.description: Amazon and Meta are said to be negotiating an end to Amazon's September block on Meta's Muse shopping agent.

item.title: CD Projekt signs a Sony marketing deal for The Witcher 4
item.description: CD Projekt has signed a marketing deal with Sony for The Witcher 4, and compares its leap over Witcher 3 to GTA V to GTA VI.

item.title: Anthropic shares fall as investors grow nervous about the AI trade
item.description: Anthropic's shares dropped on Tuesday, which Semafor links to wider investor worry about the AI market.

item.title: Francis Lawrence says an R-rated Constantine 2 script exists
item.description: Director Francis Lawrence reportedly said a script for an R-rated Constantine sequel with Keanu Reeves is written.

item.title: Netflix's The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth starts a two-week IMAX run
item.description: The Netflix film plays in IMAX cinemas from November 25 for two weeks before it premieres on the service on December 23.

item.title: Switch 2 is reportedly getting three Assassin's Creed ports
item.description: Three Assassin's Creed games are reportedly coming to Nintendo Switch 2, though the titles have not been named.

item.title: Breach at La Poste's Maileva exposes data of 22 million people
item.description: A breach at Maileva, La Poste's digital mail subsidiary in France, reportedly exposed data of 22 million people.

item.title: Mario Kart World adds eight remixed courses in a free update
item.description: A free update for Mario Kart World on Switch 2 adds eight new remixed courses, GAMINGbible reports.

item.title: US blacklists chip firm Megaspeed, and Malaysia orders data centres to cut it off
item.description: The US added Singapore's Megaspeed to its trade blacklist amid claims about Nvidia chip exports to China; Malaysia then ordered data centres to cut it off.

item.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Sol to paid ChatGPT users
item.description: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6.2 Sol to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users, promising better instruction-following.

item.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie comes to Netflix on November 30
item.description: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie joins Netflix's US library on November 30 after its Peacock run, Collider reports.

item.title: GTA VI ties Ocarina of Time with a 99 on Metacritic
item.description: GTA VI's reviews give it a Metacritic score of 99, level with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Shattered reports.

item.title: Switch 2 Mario Kart World bundle drops to $499 for Black Friday
item.description: Amazon and Walmart are selling the Switch 2 with Mario Kart World for $499, $50 below its $549 price, for a limited time.

item.title: Critical Chrome sandbox escape flaw rated 9.6 disclosed
item.description: A sandbox escape vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.6 was disclosed for Google Chrome.

item.title: Unilever reportedly cuts about 92% of its Channel 4 ad spend for influencers
item.description: Unilever has reportedly cut about 92% of its advertising on Channel 4, moving the money towards social media influencers.

item.title: NYC Council says young Kalshi users lost $8.9 million in 10 months
item.description: A New York City Council report says Kalshi users aged 18 to 20 lost $8.9 million over 10 months.

item.title: Europol operation disrupts 57 illegal streaming services
item.description: A Europol-backed operation in Seville disrupted 57 illegal IPTV services and traced €26 million in crypto payments.

item.title: GTA VI's first big patch, 1.002.002, comes with seven official fixes
item.description: Rockstar's update 1.002.002 is live on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and reports now list seven official fixes after it launched with no notes.

item.title: Ant Group releases Ling-3.2-air, an MIT-licensed multimodal model
item.description: Ant Group released Ling-3.2-air, a model that handles text, images and video, with open weights under the MIT licence.

item.title: South Korea's KEPCO says breach affected 1.5 million people
item.description: Korea Electric Power Corporation disclosed a breach of customer and procurement data affecting 1.5 million people.

item.title: Gothic 3 Classic reaches consoles about 20 years after launch
item.description: The 2006 role-playing game Gothic 3 arrived on Xbox in a Classic version on November 24, with PS5 also listed by some outlets.

item.title: PS Plus adds four more games, including Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza
item.description: PS Plus Extra and Premium added Cricket 26, Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii, MotoGP 26 and Trepang2 on November 24.

item.title: Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior, with Arkheron on day one
item.description: Xbox Game Pass adds Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 on November 24, and Arkheron launches in Game Preview on November 27.
